description:
## Tairiku X Patches 1.12.1-tairiku.4-beta.4 — experimental

Five opt-in patches. NEW: Hide search relevance prompt, targeting only the dedicated UrtTimelineRelevancePrompt feedback card in Search results (X 12.31/12.32 class m1). Preserves ordinary search posts, existing Hide sports scores, Hide Find more, Hide Who to follow and Fix external post links.

APK static class/type evidence and Java regression tests verified; device UI behavior still needs confirmation. Turn off Morphe prerelease mode to return to stable v1.12.0-tairiku.3.
